resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register says a lookout cabin sat on the foundation. Idaho Fire Lookouts, firelookout.com and the Forest Lookouts page say a 30-foot tower replaced the 1915 cabin in the 1930s. None of the sources says which structure left the foundation, so the story reports the disagreement.
Three sources say the lookout was removed and none gives a year, so no dated removal event is recorded. The removal is in status_note instead.

notes_for_editor: The 1915 cabin, the 1930s 30-foot tower and the 1922 injury agree across the sources that describe them. No source dates the removal, so the status is removed with no year. The register's foundation and remains are the only description of the site as it is now, and the willhite hiking write-up is undated and personal. The brief's conflict on coordinates (register 47.330102, -115.833571 against a 47.3502, -115.84238 Idaho record) was not checked: the Idaho Fire Lookouts page we read gives no coordinates. Do not conflate this site with a Potlatch Lumber photo titled Cedar Mountain Lookout tower (University of Idaho, plcphotos65, dated 1917, Bonner County at 47.0138, -116.5787), which is a different peak. The Idaho Fire Lookouts Cedar Mountain page under the Coeur d'Alene region (1929 crow's nest, 1934 20-foot tower, destroyed 1959) also appears to be a different peak. The Clearwater Forest list does not include this site.
